name: CT Slice Voxel Construction
aliases: Grid Cell Construction from CT Slices
definition: Constructs a 3D grid cell (voxel) from two adjacent 2D CT slices (front and back). It calculates the 3D coordinates of the 8 vertices and retrieves the scalar values (Hounsfield units) for each vertex from the respective slices.
summary: CT Slice Voxel Construction builds 3D voxels from two adjacent CT slices using slice-specific metadata and direct image array mapping, unlike normalized grid generation.
